W04

Onboarding

/app/onboarding
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P43

Confirm known identity, explain academic context and save optional preferences before the first task. Onboarding never creates enrollment or lets users choose authority.

Continue setupOpen Home
Permissions
  • Role summaries are read-only source facts.
  • Optional delivery consent is separate from required account operation.
  • A TA first task opens allocated work and does not expose release controls.
Responsive
  • Step label precedes content; steps stack on narrow web.
  • On-screen keyboard cannot cover Continue or validation messages.
Accessibility
  • Step progress is an ordered list with current step text.
  • Focus heading on step transition; label managed fields without disabled low-contrast text.
Data
  • Known identity and assigned course contexts.
  • Preference draft and acknowledged completion flags; simulated in HTML.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Skipping does not grant a role or fabricate completed consent.
  • Changing timezone previews one deadline in both zones before completion.
  • Failed save stays visibly unsaved and retains entered preferences for retry.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
